name: Precedent Panel
vision: Precedent Panel turns every DeFi price lookup into a risk snapshot: governance flags, treasury concentration, hack alerts, and historical event impacts. Powered by live data, priced per call via x402—not subscriptions.
description: Most people don't know a DAO's treasury is about to move, a governance vote is about to reshape tokenomics, or a hack is already unfolding — by the time it's news, it's too late to ask. Precedent Panel answers that by default: every price lookup returns a standardized bundle — a risk score, active governance flags, treasury concentration, and what happened to price after comparable past events — built on CoinMarketCap's live and historical pricing plus DAO governance feeds. Priced per call via x402, not a subscription, so a person or an agent can check any of ten actively-governed DeFi protocols as casually as they'd check a price.
team_description: Solo builder, not a coder, just want to learn
